title: Kenyan-Style Ssam Wrap
description: A fusion of Kenyan and Korean flavors in a crispy, savory wrap.
instructions: Prepare the masarepa dough by mixing 1 1/2 cups of cornmeal with 1/4 cup of water.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes pliable.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Cook each wrap for 1-2 minutes on each side, until lightly browned and crispy.
Assemble the ssam wrap by placing a piece of masarepa on a lettuce leaf.
Add a few slices of marinated, grilled chicken, some thinly sliced wrap, and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
Add any optional toppings, such as kimchi or avocado.
